Gorakṣanātha

(JAOS. 23, p. 313); of Svātmārāmayogin (ref. to in his Haṭhapradīpikā, TD. 6710). See [Page176-a. Mohan Singh, Gorakhnath an. Mediaeval Hindu Mysticism, p.. 48-133. Lahore, 1937; for legends connected with his life, see Briggs, Gorakhnath an. the Kānphaṭa Yogīs, p. 228 ff.

Gorakṣasaṃhitā

Ani. AS. p. 58. Bik. 1221. Dacca 333. B. 4291 (called Mokṣasopāna). Hpr. I. 99. IO. 5767. Jodhpur 946 (Sūtaprakaraṇa). 947 (Uttara Khaṇḍa). 1728-31 (Pāradavidhi from Bhūtiprakaraṇa). Lahore 20 (inc.). Mithilā. Nabadwip 308. Tagore 60. Ujjain II. p. 53. Viśvabhāratī 354 (inc.).
